home.srTitle: RIVAL ITS — Robotics Rover Research Team of Institut Teknologi Sepuluh Nopember
home.introTitle: Designing, Building, and Competing in Advanced Robotics Systems
home.introBody: RIVAL ITS is a student robotic team based in Indonesia, dedicated to design and build advanced robots for national and international competitions. Our mission is to push the boundaries of technology and innovation, while fostering a collaborative and inclusive environment for students to learn and grow.

cta.body: We design, build, and test the next generation of robots right here in Indonesia - and inspire future generations to do the same.

about.title: About RIVAL ITS
about.body: RIVAL ITS is Indonesia's premier robotics team, dedicated to pushing the boundaries of technology and innovation. Our passionate team of engineers and innovators work together to create cutting-edge robotic solutions that inspire the next generation.

partners.title: Sponsors & Partners
partners.becomeBody: We offer four different sponsorship packages: SILVER, BRONZE, WINNER, PLATINUM, and GOLD. Each one has been carefully designed to provide unique benefits tailored to the needs of our partners. Depending on the chosen package, sponsors can expect a variety of promotional opportunities, including the addition of promotional materials to the club's social media, logo exposure on promotional. Email us for more details!

arc.title: Australian Rover Challenge 2026
arc.intro: The Australian Rover Challenge (ARCh) is an annual robotics competition held by the University of Adelaide, where university students from across Australia and around the globe, battle it out in a full-scale Lunar mission, using semi-autonomous rovers that they have designed and built themselves. Competitors showcase their skills in a custom built simulated lunar environment, and complete a range of tasks including navigation, resource, and construction. Unlike many other rover competitions across the world which focus on Martian exploration, the ARCh is focused specifically on completing tasks on a simulated Lunar surface.

task1.title: Post Landing Tasks
task1.description: The rover must perform a series of activities immediately after landing to establish an operational In-Situ Resource Utilisation (ISRU) outpost, including conducting system checks, evaluating supply caches, performing maintenance, and connecting propellant hoses.

task2.title: Space Resources Task
task2.description: The rover must evaluate, collect, and extract critical lunar resources—specifically prospecting for ilmenite and icy regolith, and processing the icy regolith to extract the highest possible amount of liquid water.

task3.title: Excavation and Construction Task
task3.description: The rover must prepare a landing site by clearing hazardous rocks, excavating regolith to construct a protective berm, and deploying dust-mitigating pavers.

task4.title: Mapping and Autonomous Task
task4.description: The rover is required to autonomously navigate to predefined landmarks and subsequently explore the area to construct a comprehensive map, reporting the coordinates of previously unknown landmarks

irc.title: Indonesian Robot Contest
irc.intro: The Indonesian Robot Contest (KRI) is an annual student competition in the field of robot design and engineering, open to all university students across the Republic of Indonesia under the Ministry of Higher Education, Science, and Technology (Kemdiktisaintek). KRI is organized by the Directorate of Learning and Student Affairs, Directorate General of Higher Education of Kemdiktisaintek, Republic of Indonesia. The first KRI was held in 2003 under the Directorate General of Higher Education, Ministry of Education and Culture at that time.

task1.title: Autonomous Waste Sorting
task1.description: Robot 2 autonomously sorts waste items moving along the vibrating conveyor into five categories — ferro, nonferro, leaf, paper, and plastic. Each correctly sorted item earns 1 point.

task2.title: Trash Bin Transfer
task2.description: Robot 1 is responsible for manually moving the trash bin to the vibrating conveyor..

recruitment.title: Recruitment
recruitment.introBody1: Join the RIVAL ITS ROBOTICS TEAM and be part of the team making history by developing an Indonesian rover robot that meets world-class competition standards.
recruitment.introBody2: Through this internship recruitment program, you will receive training and gain hands-on, practical experience while developing your technical and professional skills, all within a collaborative environment and a strong engineering culture.

requirements.r1: Undergraduate student (S1/D4) at Institut Teknologi Sepuluh Nopember (ITS). Technical divisions are open to the Class of 2026 only, while non-technical divisions are open to the Class of 2025 and 2026.
requirements.r2: Demonstrate a strong willingness to learn and embrace new challenges.
requirements.r3: Able to work collaboratively in a team and perform well under pressure.
requirements.r4: Committed, responsible, and dedicated to contributing to RIVAL ITS.
requirements.r5: Willing to participate in all recruitment stages and internship programs.

mechanical.name: Mechanical
mechanical.mission: Design and manufacture durable, efficient, and competition-ready robotic structures.
mechanical.resp4: Conduct testing and improve mechanical performance.

electrical.name: Electrical
electrical.mission: Develop reliable electronic and embedded systems that power the robot's performance.
electrical.resp1: Assemble electronic components, wiring, and power systems.
electrical.resp2: Develop and integrate embedded systems using microcontrollers.
electrical.resp4: Integrate sensors and actuators into the robot.

programming.name: Programming
programming.mission: Develop intelligent software that enables the robot to perform autonomously and efficiently.
programming.focus: Software development and autonomous robot control.
programming.resp2: Implement computer vision and sensor processing.
programming.resp4: Test, debug, and optimize software performance.

creative.name: Creative & Branding
creative.desc: The Creative & Branding division handles the creation and design of all visual content related to the team, including videos, graphics, and social media management. It builds a positive and professional image of the team for public consumption.
creative.req2: Experience with video production and editing tools.
creative.req3: Creative mindset with a good eye for visual aesthetics.
creative.req4: Ability to create engaging content to promote the team's image.

external.name: Sponsorship & Public Relations
external.desc: The Sponsorship & Public Relations division manages events and agendas involving the team, maintains relationships with external stakeholders, and ensures effective public communication through social media. This division is also responsible for securing sponsorships and ensuring agreed-upon sponsorship benefits are delivered.
external.req1: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for external relations.
external.req2: Ability to negotiate and secure sponsorship deals.
external.req3: Enthusiasm for networking and maintaining external relations.
external.req4: Understanding of social media platforms for brand communication.

administration.name: Administration & Finance
administration.desc: The Administration division is responsible for organizing the team's timeline and agenda, managing general team needs, archiving important documents, handling correspondence, and completing the paperwork required for competitions.
administration.req1: Able to handle and archive documents efficiently.
administration.req2: Familiar with managing schedules and team activities.
administration.req3: Able to manage official correspondence and maintain confidentiality.
administration.req4: Committed and able to work under pressure to meet deadlines.

documents.portfolioLead: Applicants are encouraged to submit a portfolio showcasing projects or experiences relevant to their selected division, such as:
documents.portfolioTechnical1: Mechanical Division (CAD Design, 3D Modeling, Product Design, Mechanical Projects)
documents.portfolioTechnical2: Electrical Division (PCB Design, Circuit Projects, Embedded Systems, Microcontroller Projects)
documents.portfolioTechnical3: Programming Division (Software Projects, Programming Projects, Robotics Projects, Algorithm Development)
documents.portfolioNonTechnical1: Creative & Branding Division (Graphic Design, Branding, UI/UX Design, Photography, Videography, Content Creation) (Must submit the portfolio)
documents.portfolioNonTechnical2: Administration & Finance Division (Event Documentation, Reports, Financial Reports, Budgeting, Spreadsheet Projects)
documents.portfolioNonTechnical3: External Relation & Sponsorship Division (Sponsorship Proposals, Partnership Decks, Marketing Campaigns, Social Media Campaigns, Business Projects)

specialTask.adminBody: Prepare **financial statements** and a **Cost Estimate (RAB)** for RIVAL ITS TEAM to compete in the Thematic Robot Contest at Universitas Muhammadiyah Surakarta.
specialTask.externalBody1: Create a video that is at least 3 minutes and no more than 8 minutes long, in which you are a member of the RIVAL ITS Team in a single scene of the video. (English/Bahasa allowed)
specialTask.externalBody2: Just as your rival team has finished the ARCH competition and won **first place** after being nominated for **“Best Rookie Team”** in its first year at ARCH, you are approached by a representative from PT Siemens as a potential sponsor for your rival team. You must explain your rival team’s achievements and its potential to attract sponsorship, answer various questions with confidence and professionalism, and convince the sponsor through persuasive communication.
specialTask.externalInterview1: How do you feel about the ITS Rival Team’s victory?
specialTask.externalInterview2: What are the ITS Rival Team’s strengths compared to other teams?
specialTask.externalPresentation1: Deliver a presentation to a company to convince them of the benefits of sponsoring the ITS Rival Team. Speak directly without using PowerPoint or visual aids.
specialTask.creativePoint2Detail: Create a creative self-introduction video that’s at least 30 seconds long.

recruitment.applyTitle: Join the RIVAL ITS Robotics Team and be part of building the future
recruitment.applyBody: Take your first step with the RIVAL ITS Robotics Team. Choose your preferred division, submit your documents, and let’s collaborate to bring your ideas to life and build a real competition robot. Registration closes on September 24, 2026.
